heading_html: Why should fixing your AC start with a search?

columns.head: Read nine tabs, guess which one is your AC.
columns.body: A blog for a different unit. A Reddit thread from 2019. A video of somebody else's basement. None of them can see what yours is doing.

columns.head: Start with your thermostat, your filter, your unit.
columns.body: The evidence you already have narrows it faster than any general list can, because it rules things out instead of adding to them.

columns.head: A LIVE walkthrough of your actual system.
columns.body: We ask the next question based on what you just showed us, and end with a packet you can hand to any company.
